derivation.reason: The canonical build uses two joined coefficient workers outside the 18-thread FFTW execution regions; completed timing samples were preserved per user direction.
derivation.evidence: Both MEX metrics and WV_KERNEL_COEFFICIENT_WORKERS record 2; coefficient workers join before FFTW execution regions and do not nest with FFTW pthreads.
